title: Keep other types of personal information glanceable when it makes sense

statement.en: Maintain other types of personal information glanceable when it makes sense.

conditions: Apply within the platform, component, and section context identified by the source trace.

rationale.en: Applying this guidance supports a consistent and usable Always On experience on the scoped Apple platforms.
rationale.ja: この指針は、対象AppleプラットフォームにおけるAlways Onの一貫性と使いやすさを支えます。
